release_owner: Collaboration Product owner with Messaging Platform operations owner

displaced_work.disposition: preserved; no P1A or P1B scope is displaced by this proposal
capacity source to be selected and approved before implementation begins

pilot_tenants: UNSELECTED: design partner and tenant cohort require commercial approval

slos.name: message send durability
slos.target: No acknowledgement without a durable chat-database commit

slos.name: workflow protection
slos.target: Chat load must stay within the measured workflow regression budget before broad activation

slos.name: revocation
slos.target: Access revocation budget must be selected and proven before pilot activation

activation_conditions: Named design partner, target HCM workflow, adoption target, migration cost and capacity owner are approved
Cross-company authority, authorization, content and records contracts have executable acceptance evidence
Mixed-tenant capacity and recovery evidence meets the selected SLO and workflow regression budget
Pilot observation and incident contacts are recorded, then a real Gate C decision is signed
unmet_gates: No external product or commercial signer has approved the scope exchange
No design partner or pilot tenant has been selected
The company chat specification still has cross-company, authorization, records, integration and operational blockers
No implementation, all-employee activation or customer/pilot deployment is authorized by this artifact
